lead.why: The abstract names no compound ('sub-microM 20S proteasome activators based on a phenothiazine scaffold'). The paper states 'Compound 19 is by far the most potent 20S proteasome activator, with an overall EC200 of 0.4 uM ... the first reported sub-uM 20S proteasome activator' and uses 19 for the alpha-synuclein degradation and A53T cell experiments (Figures 3 and 4). Rule 2.

reactions.conditions: Chan-Lam-type coupling: aniline (3 mmol), boronic acid (6 mmol), Et3N (6 mmol), Cu(OAc)2 (3 mmol), 4 A molecular sieves, CH2Cl2, rt, under air, 16 h; 44%, yellow oil.
reactions.source: Main article, Experimental Section (Bis(4-Fluorophenyl)amine (S2)); Scheme 4 step a (48% in the scheme, 44% in the experimental)

reactions.conditions: General acylation procedure: amine (1 equiv), TEA (1.33 equiv), DCM, 0 C, acryloyl chloride (1.2 equiv) dropwise, then rt 12 h (the text and Scheme 4 say reflux 12 h); 90% (60% in the scheme).
reactions.source: Main article, Experimental Section (General Acylation Procedure; compound 14); Scheme 4 step b

reactions.conditions: General Michael addition procedure: 2-chlorophenothiazine (2 equiv), acrylamide (1 equiv), toluene, Triton B (0.5 equiv), reflux 24 h; 80% (light pink solid) in the experimental, 50% in Scheme 4.
reactions.source: Main article, Experimental Section (General Michael Addition Procedure; compound 19); Scheme 4 step c

notes: Three steps. The paper never says its starting materials were purchased (no supplier statement at all); 4-fluoroaniline, 4-fluorophenylboronic acid, acryloyl chloride and 2-chlorophenothiazine are used without preparation and treated as commercial. Yields differ between Scheme 4 (48%, 60%, 50%) and the Experimental (44%, 90%, 80%); the Scheme 4 footnote says the acylation was at reflux, the general procedure says rt. Triton B (benzyltrimethylammonium hydroxide) is a base catalyst and not listed. Names of the amine, boronic acid and 2-chlorophenothiazine are derived (printed only as 4-fluoroaniline, 4-fluorophenyl boronic acid and 2-chlorophenothiazine in the text).
